name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Push Press
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart holding one kettlebell in the front rack position on one side with your elbow tucked close to your ribs.
Keep your torso tall and perform a quick, shallow knee dip while keeping your heels planted.
Drive explosively upward through your legs and use that momentum to press the kettlebell straight overhead to full arm lockout.
Lower the bell under control back to the front rack, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Do not hinge forward during the dip; keep your torso straight up and down.
Brace your core at lockout to prevent your ribs from flaring upward.
